verdict.rationale: Bevy documents a custom ECS that runs all engine and game logic, using plain Rust components and systems, which covers the data-oriented part of the story. The evidence pack contains nothing about a profiler, a job or parallel-task system, or GPU instancing, so only about half the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: a documented real profiler or tracing integration, job/parallel scheduling evidence, instancing support, and independent hands-on evidence of scaling heavy scenes.
